CHECK BURST CS-assets-spawn — cut, register and catalogue the isolated props as reusable assets, and rebuild the cluttered crop from bare ground + shadows + assets (Matt R-C3-61/62/64). REPORT ONLY. task_id "CS-assets-spawn".

Inputs (read-only): isolated sheets /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-objiso-spawn-1/objiso_spawn_1.png and /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-objiso-spawn-2/objiso_spawn_2.png (props on #00ff00); the sheet layout /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-clutter-canvases/objsheet_spawn_layout.json (per tile: id, crop_box in crop px [x0,y0,x1,y1], sheet_xy, sheet_size, scale 2); BEFORE /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-clutter-canvases/clutter_spawn_canvas.png; AFTER /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-clutter-spawn/clutter_spawn.png; crop origin in the level /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-clutter-canvases/clutter_spawn.json; the diff report /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-clutter-spawn-x/objects.json. Frozen tool /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/gates/matte.py (extract, edge_mode='clamp') for the green key. python glue PIL/numpy/scipy; no new tool files.

STEP 1 — per tile: cut sheet_xy+sheet_size from its sheet, clamp-matte → RGBA, downscale 0.5 (premultiplied LANCZOS) to the crop_box size.
STEP 2 — REGISTRATION CHECK: for each tile, search integer shifts ±10 px minimising mean |RGB| between the RGBA (alpha ≥ 200 pixels) and AFTER at crop_box; report best shift and residual; if |shift| > 3 px on any axis or the residual > 18, flag it. Apply the best shift.
STEP 3 — SPLIT INTO ASSETS: connected components of alpha ≥ 32 (8-connected, dilate 3 px for grouping); drop components touching the tile border (spill-over from a neighbouring prop) and components < 150 px; each remaining component is one asset. Name assets by kind from this list, matched by position within the tile and appearance: sheet 1 — obj_05: charred_log, fern_a, fern_b, shrub_a; obj_03: crate_single; obj_01: boulder_mossy_large, rock_small_a; obj_02: crate_stack2. Sheet 2 — obj_06: boulder_round, shrub_flower; obj_07: boulder_halfsunk; obj_04: barrel_broken. If a count does not match, report it and name the extras kind_unknown_N.
STEP 4 — SHADOWS: for each tile region in crop px, R = luminance(AFTER)/luminance(BEFORE) after a 15-px Gaussian blur of both; shadow strength s = clip(1 − R, 0, 0.75) where the pixel is NOT inside any asset alpha (dilated 2 px), else 0; zero s where s < 0.06; soften 3 px. Save per tile shadow as RGBA (RGB = the median BEFORE−AFTER colour ratio tint darkened, or pure black if simpler — report which), alpha = s.
STEP 5 — CATALOGUE + REBUILD: out/assets/<name>.png (tight RGBA, 2-px transparent pad) ; out/shadows/<obj_id>_shadow.png; out/assets.json = per asset {name, kind, source_obj, file, size_px, anchor = bottom-centre of its lowest opaque row (sort line) in asset px, level_position_px of that anchor (crop px + origin), footprint_px (x-span of bottom 10 rows, height 0.35× width as an ellipse), light_dir 'upper-left', register 'H1', scale_ref 'Keeper 130 px', provenance {clutter edit burst, isolate burst, sheet, tile}}. out/rebuild.png = BEFORE + all shadows (multiply by (1−alpha·k)) + all assets (over, sorted by anchor y); out/rebuild_vs_after.png = rebuild | AFTER | |diff|×3, side by side at 768×512 each; out/asset_sheet.png = every asset over mid-grey and over magenta at 1×, labelled; out/summary.txt ≤ 15 lines (asset count, registration flags, mean |rebuild−AFTER| inside the object regions and outside). No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 14 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-assets-spawn"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
